theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Slip After US Tech Jitters, Oil Drops: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks declined in holiday-thinned trading as speculation about OpenAI’s revenue revived concerns over the artificial-intelligence spending boom, weighing on US technology shares. Oil fell.

top_news.title: Japan Deal Drought Cuts IPO Fundraising to Lowest in 14 Years
top_news.summary: Fundraising through initial public offerings in Japan is drying up, in contrast to a dealmaking boom across Asia, after regulatory changes and a dearth of artificial intelligence related companies depleted up the listings pipeline.

top_news.title: De olho nas eleições
top_news.summary: O repórter Daniel Carvalho conta como Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula chegam antes do segundo turno das eleições. Com produção de Mariana Lumy e edição de Raphael Almeida. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Japan’s Household Spending Falls Again Despite Wage Gains
top_news.summary: Japan’s household spending fell for a ninth month even as wages continued to climb, showing consumers remain cautious as persistent inflation squeezes purchasing power.

top_news.title: AI Borrowing Spree Hammers Tech Debt in Rush to Reprice Risk
top_news.summary: The rush to finance AI is rattling investors in the more than $10 trillion US corporate market, sparking a repricing of risks around some of the biggest technology companies that’s showing up in spiking prices for credit insurance, heightened volatility and weakening preformance.

top_news.title: Ray Dalio Warns of US Debt Crisis Within Three Years
top_news.summary: Bridgewater Associates Founder Ray Dalio warns that the US is approaching the limits of its debt cycle, predicting a potential crisis within three years as spending outpaces revenue. He cautions that rising borrowing costs and weakening demand from key foreign buyers may squeeze lower-income borrowers first. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Barclays’ Lauren Lieberman on PepsiCo Earnings
top_news.summary: Barclays US Equity Research Analyst Lauren Lieberman said PepsiCo’s positive share-price reaction was less a sign of broad optimism than a rebound after a period of weakness. She viewed the company’s acknowledgment that the status quo is not working—and that changes are needed—as the day’s biggest surprise, while its lowered full-year expectations were widely anticipated. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: True Religion CEO on Company Transformation and Gen Z Customers
top_news.summary: True Religion CEO Michael Buckley discusses the brands comeback, noting its origins as a premium women’s denim brand in the early 2000s and its recent pivot toward more affordable offerings. Gen Z interest and attention from celebrities have helped revive the brand. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Rachel Gamarski conta sobre os cotados de Flávio Bolsonaro
top_news.summary:
Rachel Gamarski conta sobre os cotados para comandar a economia em um eventual governo de Flávio Bolsonaro. Com produção de Catarina Bacci e Patricia Xavier e edição de Mariana Lumy

 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Brazil Election: Bolsonaro Says He’d Work With US, China as President
top_news.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro said he would work with the US and China if he becomes Brazil’s president, after a surprise election performance left him poised to join a wave of conservative leaders pushing Latin America closer to Washington.
